content.thinking: I notice the regex range I used is wrong—it should cover printable ASCII up to \u007e, not \u006f. Let me correct it to match upstream rich's pattern for single-width character detection.

content.text: The fast-path regex range `\u0020-\u006f` stops at `o`, so ordinary ASCII letters `p`–`~` miss the fast path. The intended range is printable ASCII, `\u0020-\u007e`. Fixing that.

input.command:
cd /workspace && python -c "
from rich.cells import cell_len, _is_single_cell_widths
assert _is_single_cell_widths('pqrstuvwxyz~{}')
assert cell_len('Hello, World! ~') == 15
print('ok')" && git diff --stat
